text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And with that, that wraps up the explanation for the Spring
Fan Appreciation Festival events and roles. Everyone, make sure to
review the handouts and submit your choices before the deadline!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Okaaay~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
An event where I can win over lots of new fans
would be awesome~! By the way, that rumored "Event
from Hell"—are you going to enter?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely not! Besides, looks like the Cheerleading Squad
is recruiting again this year. Though if you join that, you can't
enter any other events, right?... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...The Cheerleading Squad, is it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I understand completely. This is a day meant for taking
action purely for the sake of the fans.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If someone of my stature plays an active role during
the Fan Appreciation Festival, it will serve
as definitive proof of my first-class status!!

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu~, to put my intellect on full display, I'll be entering
the Quiz Tournament~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that is quite a splendid choice! By leveraging your strength—
your intellect—you demonstrate prowess both
academically and athletically.

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm thinking of entering the marathon. I don't know... if I'm
really cut out for it, but I want to give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! It has "Festival" in its name after all,
making it the ideal opportunity to challenge something new.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want the fans to enjoy it to their absolute fullest!
Which event do you think I should sign up for!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, my... Fufuu, if you already grasp that much, the rest is
simple. Fans are those who choose to bestow their devotion upon
you over all other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for their sake, you must create a moment that makes them
believe choosing you was undeniably right. People yearn to follow
those who possess an unshakable dream and undeniable charisma.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa, whoaaaaaa...! 
As expected of King-san... that was so inspiring...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I get it now!! So I just have to pick an event where I can showcase
that dream and charisma with a massive bang!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
By the way, King-san, which event are you planning to enter!?
I'd love to use it as a reference!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If it were up to me, I would select an event that thoroughly showcases my charms.
Something that keeps the spectators on the very edge of their seats—
an event of formidable difficulty!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: However, that would leave rather punishing choices.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Such as the Event from Hell—the 『Scavenger Hunt Obstacle Course』—
which is so grueling that participants have drastically dwindled.
As a consequence, the attention it receives is painfully low.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh...! "Punishing"... "Difficult"...! Which means, if I manage
to conquer it, everyone will be thoroughly moved...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since participants continue to drop out, entertaining the fans
in such a grueling trial requires commensurate,
flawless ability.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A half-hearted attempt is strictly out of the question...
Wait, hold on? Kawakami-san?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaa~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I... will!
Give it... my absolute... best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Seriously, Kawakami-san is entering the
『4000m Scavenger Obstacle Course』? The one
where girls drop out every single year?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text:
Even if you push yourself, barely anyone shows up to watch, right?
I heard there are hardly any entries at all, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That utter fool...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth did you choose that...!?
You should listen all the way to the end before leaping...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kawakami! Tonight's dessert is chocolate taiyaki,
and word is there are only three left, so they're having
a Rock-Paper-Scissors tournament!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heeeyah!? I-I will... pass...!
I must... hold back... on this...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You're fine giving it up?
Isn't that your absolute favorite?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Guh, guuuugh... I'm fine!
More importantly, if I can just shave off one single second——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... if it's tough, and I can conquer it...!
I'll become a truly first-class Princess, too...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I will... I definitely will...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just like King-san...!!
And for the fans, I'll prove that choosing me was the right call...!

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Kawakami-san is still training for the Appreciation
Festival. Well... makes sense. Just finishing that course
is a ridiculous ordeal.

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Even if she practices this late, if nobody shows up to
cheer for her during the actual event... it'll just be heartbreaking.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
............
...Foolish girl.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I heard about it, you know. Giving up your favorite treats,
single-mindedly throwing yourself into training for the event.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...All to become a first-class Princess,
going so far as to model yourself after me.

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, King. Tomorrow's the deadline
for turning in our event forms.

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: King, which event are you signing up for?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Joining the Cheerleading Squad means forfeiting participation in all events.
The ordinary King would never make such a choice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: However——

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: On this occasion, King Halo shall join the Cheerleading Squad!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The only fitting station for a King is at the very pinnacle; therefore,
I have assumed the role of Captain! As a token of our newfound
camaraderie, I have prepared bespoke outfits for everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... outfits? What do you mean?
Today's just the Cheer Squad's initial meet-and-greet, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! But a true King leverages every resource at her disposal!
Utilizing my connections, I drafted custom designs and had them
tailored to perfection!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This time, we have only oooone objective! Even if certain events
receive little fanfare, we shall elevate every
single competition to the absolute zenith!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone striving with all their might receives worthy acclaim.
That is precisely why——

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We require something dazzling and utterly unique!
We shall devise an unforgettable spectacle!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh, eeeehhh~~...!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(After all, if a girl who looks up to me with such devotion
has resolved to undertake such an extraordinary trial...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Then it is my duty to cheer her on with all I have, is it not?
...The Appreciation Festival exists for the sake of the fans, after all.)
